summary: As an Associate Principal Account Solution Architect at Red Hat, I bring over 20 years of IT experience. Expert in cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes, and enterprise solutions, I advise large enterprise organizations on their digital transformation and open source technology adoption. Passionate about technological innovation and knowledge sharing, I support teams in designing and implementing robust, scalable solutions.

experience.title: Associate Principal Solutions Architect
experience.description: Strategic technical advisor for large enterprise accounts, with a strong focus on AI infrastructure and sovereign platforms. Lead architect for BNP Paribas LLM-as-a-Service & GPU-as-a-Service platforms. Design and governance of OpenShift / OpenShift AI platforms in regulated environments. 20,000+ internal users across 25+ entities, 250 on-prem GPUs (H100/H200) operated as GPUaaS.

experience.title: Senior Account Solutions Architect
experience.description: Global technical lead for BNP Paribas, covering AI, hybrid cloud, security, and automation. AI Infrastructure: LLM-as-a-Service on OpenShift AI (vLLM, GPU Grid). Hybrid Cloud: resilient architectures across on-prem and multi-cloud. Security: software supply chain, artifact signing, confidential containers. Automation: Ansible Automation Platform at enterprise scale. Enabled sovereign, compliant GenAI adoption in banking. Managed automation platforms with 100,000+ nodes via Ansible.

experience.title: Lead Solution Engineer - Strategic Account
experience.description: Led technical aspects of the sales process, helping customers achieve business objectives through Kubernetes and Cloud Native applications in multi-cloud contexts. Delivered a DevSecOps platform hosting mission-critical connectivity services for Nordnet.

experience.title: Cloud Program Manager
experience.description: Led Orange France 'Go Transform' Program to accelerate business transformation using Cloud, DATA and AI. Managed the Google Cloud Partnership for Orange France.

experience.title: Solutions Architect
experience.description: Designed scalable, flexible and resilient architectures addressing customer business problems to accelerate Cloud adoption.

experience.title: Cloud Department Manager
experience.description: Managed 25 internal experts who Build and Run a Cloud infrastructure for container-based applications hosting critical workloads. Product Owner for software operability. Migrated 80+ Legacy projects. Availability up to 99.9999%. Tech Stack: VMware vSphere, Kubernetes, CloudFoundry, ELK, GitLab-CI, Prometheus, Grafana, Ansible, Terraform.

experience.title: DevOps Team Manager
experience.description: Orange Money Mobile Payment Solution deployment in 15 countries. Led DevOps transformation. Managed distributed teams in France, India, Tunisia, and Africa.
